title: Taxon-scoped existence axiom
description: One curated claim that, in a named taxon, an anatomical structure's existence starts or ends at a named developmental stage. One row per claim: a structure with both a start and an end bound has two rows. This table is the source of truth; the OWL is generated from it.

uberon_id.description: The anatomical structure the claim is about. Must be a current Uberon class, not an obsolete or merged one.

uberon_label.description: Uberon's label for uberon_id, carried for human review only. Validation checks it against the ontology; it is never the identifier.

taxon_id.description: The taxon the claim is scoped to. This is what makes the axiom a GCI rather than a species-neutral assertion, and it is why the claim can be true without being true of the structure in every organism.

taxon_label.description: NCBITaxon's label for taxon_id, for review only.

onset_type.description: The curator's judgement about the shape of the claim, from which `predicate` follows. `point`: the structure has a definable onset or offset, so an exact stage can be named and can be wrong. `interval`: the structure appears or resolves progressively across several stages (somites, pharyngeal arch derivatives, serial condensations), so only a bound is assertable. `single-stage`: the structure exists within one stage only. Symmetry is not the criterion -- paired structures can be progressive.

predicate.description: existence starts during (RO:0002488), existence ends during (RO:0002492), existence starts and ends during (RO:0002491), existence starts during or after (RO:0002496), existence ends during or before (RO:0002497). Must agree with onset_type: point takes 0002488/0002492, interval takes 0002496/0002497, single-stage takes 0002491.

stage_id.description: The developmental stage, from the stage ontology matching taxon_id. Must be consistent with the taxon: an HsapDv stage with a non-human taxon is an error validation rejects.

stage_label.description: The stage ontology's label for stage_id, for review only.

evidence_code.description: ECO code for how the claim is supported. Empty means no evidence has been attached yet, which is the state every row starts in and none should ship in.

evidence_text.description: Free text saying what is being claimed and why, in terms a curator can check against a source. This is the part a reviewer actually reads.

source.description: Where the claim comes from: a DOI, PMID, ISBN, or URL. Empty means unsourced.

curator.description: Who made the call. The literal value `latent` marks a claim seeded from a language model's background knowledge and not yet checked by a person -- it is a to-do, not a provenance.

date.description: ISO date the row was last touched.

status.description: `proposed`: drafted, not reviewed. `accepted`: a curator has checked it against the source. `superseded`: kept for the record, excluded from the build.
